title: Qt: Timeline Delegate and Percent Bar Delegate colors
description:
In an item view, the background color is Base, except when
alternating row colors as used, in which case AlternateBase
is used on alternate rows. The foreground text color is Text.

Window and WindowText are other colors. On many palettes, WindowText
and Text are the same, but Base is more bright white whereas Window
is somewhat darker. However, on GTK3 (and thus the platform theme
for Qt derived from it), Window and Base are the same.

The current color used for the percent bar and for the timeline
in the Conversation Dialog is a blend of Window and WindowText,
strongly tilted towards Window. On systems where Window is darker
than Base (and AlternateBase), this is considerably darker (and
more visible), but on the rare systems where they are the same,
it is quite light and difficult to see.

Have the bar color be a blend between the text foreground and
background colors, somewhat more tilted towards the foreground
color than currently. This should be similar on most platforms,
but more visible on the GTK3 platform theme. It also makes sense
to blend the foreground and background colors, instead of involving
different colors in the palette.

AI-Assisted: no
